tasks.title: Freeze the final objective
tasks.instruction: Resolve universe, A/ADR/H class rules, horizon, currency, dividends, liquidity constraints and source cutoff. Output: Run contract.

tasks.title: Validate the clock
tasks.instruction: Record quote time, timezone, last completed exchange session, target exchange session and report availability. Output: Clock map.

tasks.title: Quarantine prior work
tasks.instruction: Extract prior claims as hypotheses; reopen original filings before reusing any numeric claim. Output: Quarantine log.

tasks.title: Preserve source lineage
tasks.instruction: Store publication and observation dates, original author, archive/hash and exact page/table. Output: Source ledger.

tasks.title: Distinguish fact types
tasks.instruction: Tag observed fact, company claim, derivation, model assumption, unresolved or contradicted. Output: Claim ledger.

tasks.title: Explore independently
tasks.instruction: Map at least 12 distinct market pools before narrowing; include slower markets with valuation dislocations. Output: Market-pool inventory.

tasks.title: Record rejection logic
tasks.instruction: Log every screened name, evidence depth and reason; a shallow screen is not a completed valuation. Output: Universe log.

tasks.title: Seek adjacent beneficiaries
tasks.instruction: Trace where customer spend and supplier profit move after each bottleneck is relieved. Output: Beneficiary graph.

tasks.title: Decompose rates
tasks.instruction: Separate risk-free rates, credit spreads and refinancing exposure; distinguish demand-financing from valuation effects. Output: Rate transmission.

tasks.title: Trace FX
tasks.instruction: Separate revenue translation, input currency, monetary balances, hedges and OCI. Output: FX exposure map.

tasks.title: Trace energy and logistics
tasks.instruction: Map electricity, fuel, feedstock, freight and route/insurance changes to specific stages and lags. Output: Input transmission.

tasks.title: Trace policy mechanically
tasks.instruction: Record enacted rules, dates and affected geography; separate announcements from effective implementation. Output: Policy transmission.

tasks.title: Separate real demand from inflation
tasks.instruction: Split nominal growth into units, price, mix and currency; distinguish bookings and installed utilization. Output: Macro-to-units bridge.

tasks.title: Define the unit
tasks.instruction: Choose grade, specification, width/area/weight, voltage/rate, geography and period before counting supply. Output: Unit dictionary.

tasks.title: Draw physical and cash flows
tasks.instruction: Record buyer/supplier links, captive use, inventory owners, payment terms and revenue recognition. Output: Chain map.

tasks.title: Find shared bottlenecks
tasks.instruction: Identify common foundries, tooling, skilled labor, power, qualification and equipment vendors. Output: Constraint map.

tasks.title: Build end-customer deployment cohorts
tasks.instruction: Start with named projects/customers and funded units; separate orders, cancellations, installations and utilization. Output: Demand cohorts.

tasks.title: Model content
tasks.instruction: Derive material/device content from BOM, layers, channels, links, compute or service workloads. Output: Content model.

tasks.title: Model economic adoption
tasks.instruction: Calculate break-even thresholds by customer type; estimate the addressable subset, not all nominal units. Output: Adoption map.

tasks.title: Model replacement and inventory
tasks.instruction: Track product lifetime, installed base, stock drawdowns, restocking and channel duplication. Output: Consumption/order bridge.

tasks.title: Check funding and complements
tasks.instruction: Cap deployments by financing, permits, power, skilled labor, supporting components or reimbursement. Output: Feasible-demand cap.

tasks.title: Independent demand cross-check
tasks.instruction: Compare bottom-up units with physical output/shipments and competitor/customer reports. Output: Demand reconciliation.

tasks.title: Inventory every material project
tasks.instruction: Track announced, funded, equipment secured, built, commissioned, qualified and ramping capacity. Output: Capacity ledger.

tasks.title: Reconcile dates across periods
tasks.instruction: Compare original schedules, revisions, actual starts, cancellations and delays. Output: Project change log.

tasks.title: Convert nameplate to effective output
tasks.instruction: Convert annual capacity to period output; apply stage limits, uptime, yield and customer qualification. Output: Qualified supply.

tasks.title: Model grade allocation
tasks.instruction: Use machine-hours or equivalent constraints; faster growth of one grade can reduce another grade's supply. Output: Allocation model.

tasks.title: Include rational competitor response
tasks.instruction: Model output increases, cold repairs, debottlenecking, substitution, imports and new entrants. Output: Response paths.

tasks.title: Avoid double counting
tasks.instruction: Remove captive/intermediate duplication; reconcile parent/subsidiary and OEM/foundry quantities. Output: Supply audit.

tasks.title: Build comparable price series
tasks.instruction: Match grade, unit, tax/freight basis, region, currency, order size and contract duration. Output: Price ledger.

tasks.title: Separate announced and realized pricing
tasks.instruction: Build order cohorts with effective dates, renegotiation scope, discounts and delivery lags. Output: Realized ASP model.

tasks.title: Trace input cost into COGS
tasks.instruction: Match procurement cohorts, inventory method, production and sale timing; separate capex inputs. Output: Cost-roll-through model.

tasks.title: Prove bargaining power
tasks.instruction: Compare seller price/cost/volume with buyer procurement costs, margins, retention and payment terms. Output: Surplus-allocation bridge.

tasks.title: Find normalization mechanism
tasks.instruction: Determine marginal supplier, substitutable capacity, customer alternatives and expected inventory balance. Output: Multi-period price path.

tasks.title: Compare like for like
tasks.instruction: Control workload, process, reach, power, accuracy, reliability, environment and system boundary. Output: Benchmark matrix.

tasks.title: Convert component to system gain
tasks.instruction: Apply workload fractions and other constraints; do not extrapolate a component maximum to the full system. Output: System benefit model.

tasks.title: Include alternatives and future roadmaps
tasks.instruction: Compare do-nothing, internal design, incumbents, substitutes and feasible rival roadmaps. Output: Counter-technology map.

tasks.title: Classify maturity
tasks.instruction: Separate simulation, prototype, qualification, pilot shipment, volume production and fleet results. Output: Maturity ledger.

tasks.title: Build full lifecycle TCO
tasks.instruction: Include redesign, integration, downtime, training, certification, support, financing and replacement. Output: Customer TCO.

tasks.title: Prevent benefit double counting
tasks.instruction: Do not count freed labor as both cash saving and incremental output; use contribution, not gross revenue. Output: Economic audit.

tasks.title: Model switching symmetrically
tasks.instruction: Measure cost to adopt and cost to leave; assess multisourcing, contract renewal and open-source ownership. Output: Switching-cost map.

tasks.title: Construct the real denominator
tasks.instruction: Define merchant versus captive, geography, applications, value share and unit share. Output: Contestable SAM.

tasks.title: Build design-win/retention cohorts
tasks.instruction: Track eligible programs, nominations, qualification, production units, losses, cancellations and renewal. Output: Share conversion model.

tasks.title: Validate share independently
tasks.instruction: Check wins/losses, market-normalized shipments, gross profit per unit and competitor response. Output: Share validation.

tasks.title: Model rational resource allocation
tasks.instruction: Optimize contribution per constrained hour/unit, not price per item; include commitments and financing. Output: Management response.

tasks.title: Test management incentives
tasks.instruction: Examine compensation, related parties, acquisitions, dilution, capitalized costs and reinvestment returns. Output: Incentive exceptions.

tasks.title: Build multi-period panel
tasks.instruction: Default: 12 quarters plus five annual periods; include a complete prior supply cycle where material. Output: Comparable panel.

tasks.title: Normalize reporting
tasks.instruction: Reconcile fiscal calendars, units, share changes, consolidations, tax, acquisition mix and recurring items. Output: Normalization bridge.

tasks.title: Decompose revenue and gross profit
tasks.instruction: Separate volume, like-for-like price, mix, FX, acquisitions and new products; leave no invented residual. Output: Price-volume-mix bridge.

tasks.title: Build cost and expense cohorts
tasks.instruction: Map materials, inventory, yield, labor, depreciation, freight, R&D, SBC and financing separately. Output: Forward statements.

tasks.title: Reconcile cash and dilution
tasks.instruction: Bridge NI to CFO, capex, acquisitions, debt, leases, convertibles, buybacks and period-end cash. Output: Cash/share bridge.

tasks.title: Freeze a holdout quarter
tasks.instruction: Calibrate with earlier data; test a withheld quarter before incorporating it into the model. Output: Backtest residuals.

tasks.title: Classify deviations
tasks.instruction: Separate demand, supply, price, mix, share, execution, timing, tax and one-offs. Output: Error attribution.

tasks.title: Build point-in-time valuation history
tasks.instruction: Use price and earnings available on that date; handle splits, rights, dividends and updated denominators. Output: Historical PE bridge.

tasks.title: Keep business and belief states separate
tasks.instruction: Construct several conditional belief vectors compatible with today's price, not a unique implied consensus. Output: Belief-state map.

tasks.title: Test already-public information
tasks.instruction: Identify preannouncements, scheduled events and prior price response; distinguish fact availability from investor understanding. Output: Known/unknown ledger.

tasks.title: Map information to recognition
tasks.instruction: For each in-window event, name the later operating variable and expectation it changes. Output: Catalyst bridge.

tasks.title: Keep a common earnings denominator
tasks.instruction: Show price-change decomposition using the same future fiscal year and explicit dilution. Output: Target bridge.

tasks.title: Cross-check price, cash and market share
tasks.instruction: Use demand/share economics, suitable multiples and properly discounted cash; reconcile discrepancies. Output: Valuation reconciliation.

tasks.title: Test cycle/terminal consistency
tasks.instruction: Growth, reinvestment, ROIC, payout, capex and margins must coexist economically. Output: Duration audit.

tasks.title: Attack the winning premise
tasks.instruction: Find earlier rival capacity, weaker customer surplus, channel inventory, false exposure and double-counted options. Output: Counter-thesis.

tasks.title: Run hard numerical checks
tasks.instruction: Check mass balance, shares, dates, period subtraction, units, cash and forecast timestamp availability. Output: Audit report.

tasks.title: Publish one point path per eligible candidate
tasks.instruction: Rank horizon appreciation only; show risks and break-even thresholds separately, without probability weighting. Output: Decision worksheet.

tasks.title: Update only changed inputs
tasks.instruction: Propagate new source facts through dependency graph; log target/rank changes and causes. Output: Versioned change log.

tasks.title: Assess without hindsight
tasks.instruction: Compare operational forecasts, expected belief changes, multiple changes and actual price separately. Output: Learning ledger.

tasks.title: Create the disclosure universe
tasks.instruction: List target filings, corrections, acquisition documents, subsidiaries, bonds, notes and all material chain peers by period. Output: Document manifest.

tasks.title: Enumerate every quantitative disclosure
tasks.instruction: Capture every amount, ratio, unit, schedule and numeric narrative in scoped documents; record exclusions, unreadable cells and duplicates. Output: Number census.

tasks.title: Read notes that alter small denominators
tasks.instruction: Review taxes, inventory provisions, rebates, SBC, receivable terms, guarantees, covenants, leases, factoring and capitalized costs even when small. Output: Footnote-to-driver map.

tasks.title: Preserve original and restated versions
tasks.instruction: Store first release and each correction; never replace original forecast labels silently with restated financials. Output: Vintage ledger.

tasks.title: Diff consecutive report wording
tasks.instruction: Compare changes in delivery language, price terms, capacity milestones, customer concentrations and removed disclosures. Output: Text and table change log.

tasks.title: Expand related-company coverage adaptively
tasks.instruction: Start with buyers, suppliers and rivals; recursively follow any newly revealed material dependencies or substitute capacities. Output: Exposure graph.

tasks.title: Document original source independence
tasks.instruction: Group syndicated reports, repeated management quotes and commissioned research under their originating evidence cluster. Output: Origin map.

tasks.title: Segment the economic decision maker
tasks.instruction: Separate operator, budget holder, OEM, channel, end user and regulator; identify who gains and who pays. Output: Customer decision map.

tasks.title: Compare feasible alternatives
tasks.instruction: Price incumbent renewal, defer, internal build, substitute product and best challenger under identical workload and lifecycle. Output: Choice set.

tasks.title: Model adoption and switching separately
tasks.instruction: Separate initial introduction, incumbent-exit friction and future exit cost; include dual-running, financing, certification and retraining. Output: Incremental NPV.

tasks.title: Derive willingness-to-pay ceilings
tasks.instruction: Solve price that leaves hurdle NPV/payback satisfied; distinguish total ecosystem surplus from supplier pricing capture. Output: Reservation-price schedule.

tasks.title: Translate ROI to fundable cohorts
tasks.instruction: Identify budgets, capex cycles, procurement deadlines, minimum return and cash affordability before allocating adoption. Output: Funded demand cohorts.

tasks.title: Apply physical deployment bottlenecks
tasks.instruction: Cap economic demand by integrators, power, permits, reliability validation, personnel, components and allowed commissioning slots. Output: Deployable demand.

tasks.title: Model replacement, deferral and cannibalization
tasks.instruction: Track installed stock age, early replacement, reuse, competing generations and retirements; count each opportunity once. Output: Stock-flow model.

tasks.title: Choose timescales by economics
tasks.instruction: Use event/daily clocks for shocks, monthly near-term operations, quarterly finances and annual lifecycle; never stop at price horizon. Output: Calendar and bridge.

tasks.title: Link learning curves to adoption
tasks.instruction: Estimate cost/yield learning from pre-cutoff history; let price declines expand addressable cohorts without assuming perfect supplier capture. Output: Endogenous adoption curve.

tasks.title: Model rivals' constrained responses
tasks.instruction: Allocate shared capacity by contribution per bottleneck-hour and funded expansion NPV, with contracts and incentive constraints. Output: Response ledger.

tasks.title: Check equilibrium and conservation
tasks.instruction: Reconcile supplies, purchases, stocks and consumption; rerun customer choice after pricing changes; report no-convergence instead of forcing a price. Output: Balance audit.

tasks.title: Register anticipated new factors
tasks.instruction: Before each forecast, enumerate announced price letters, contract renewals, shutdowns, capacity starts, funding maturities, subsidies, FX hedges and taxes. Output: New-factor register.

tasks.title: Separate expectation from physical effect
tasks.instruction: Store announcement, effective date, delivery, COGS recognition, cash and investor-recognition dates independently. Output: Transmission schedule.

tasks.title: Model amplitude, duration and recovery
tasks.instruction: Specify evidence-based intensity, exposure, decay/ramp and management response; distinguish transitory levels from structural slope changes. Output: Shock kernel.

tasks.title: Stress events not forecastable ex ante
tasks.instruction: Apply deterministic exposure tests for unannounced interruptions or customer loss; label them stresses, not primary-path predictions. Output: Fragility tests.

tasks.title: Declare forecast lanes
tasks.instruction: Separate unguided structural forecast, guidance-assisted nowcast, post-release attribution and forward paper test. Output: Lane registry.

tasks.title: Enforce source lineage recursively
tasks.instruction: An input is unavailable if any required ancestor or revised version became public after forecast origin. Output: Availability graph.

tasks.title: Design chronological splits
tasks.instruction: With adequate history use a 20-quarter training, 4-quarter validation, 4-quarter sealed test illustration; adjust to real economic cycle. Output: Split manifest.

tasks.title: Define grouped and regime holdouts
tasks.instruction: Group issuer families and tightly linked programs when testing transfer; reserve entire adverse and expansion regimes rather than isolated lucky quarters. Output: Group/regime map.

tasks.title: Purge overlapping target information
tasks.instruction: Exclude training labels not available by each origin and remove overlaps in target intervals; use embargo only for identified leakage paths. Output: Purged split audit.

tasks.title: Select benchmarks and metrics in advance
tasks.instruction: Use seasonal naive, run-rate and guidance baselines; define revenue errors, margin-bps errors, EPS dollar errors and cash-flow errors. Output: Metric contract.

tasks.title: Lock the feature and prompt search budget
tasks.instruction: Record every tried structural model, prompt version and hyperparameter choice; do not select retrospectively on the final test. Output: Experiment registry.

tasks.title: Seal target access
tasks.instruction: Enforce separate input and label paths, evaluator-only permissions and redacted tool responses; do not trust prompt instructions as an access boundary. Output: Access manifest.

tasks.title: Freeze and hash each forecast
tasks.instruction: Save source versions, model code, prompts, parameters, seed, horizon and predictions before a target result is accessible. Output: Forecast receipt.

tasks.title: Score once and preserve the result
tasks.instruction: Evaluate sealed targets under registered metrics; any later retuning begins a new experiment and cannot reuse the same test as pristine. Output: Blind evaluation.

tasks.title: Audit LLM historical contamination
tasks.instruction: Mark all retrospective LLM tests as contamination-sensitive unless historical outcomes could not be known; prefer prospective shadow tests. Output: Contamination disclosure.

tasks.title: Run prospective paper forecasts
tasks.instruction: Before each future release, archive predictions and input packet; score when public results arrive without respecifying the old forecast. Output: Forward record.

tasks.title: Separate as-reported and restated error
tasks.instruction: Score first-public actuals for announcement prediction and subsequently restated outcomes for economic truth, with separate series. Output: Dual-label score.

tasks.title: Detect compensating errors
tasks.instruction: Check volume/price/cost/tax/share forecasts individually even when aggregate EPS is accurate. Output: Driver error bridge.

tasks.title: Attribute shocks without hindsight rescue
tasks.instruction: Explain post-release changes in an attribution notebook only; keep the original blind loss and label new evidence after-origin. Output: Postmortem.

tasks.title: Build a change driver for every material line
tasks.instruction: Map price, units, FX, tax, useful lives, rebates, cost cohorts, cash timings and consolidation; residuals stay explicit. Output: Line-item driver tree.

tasks.title: Reconcile cash with commercial timing
tasks.instruction: Use payment contracts and actual collection history; advances, factoring and notes are not revenue or automatic bargaining power. Output: Cash mechanism.

tasks.title: Audit incentives and related entities
tasks.instruction: Follow parent/subsidiary value capture, transfer pricing, external contracts, minority interests and capital allocation. Output: Entity economics.

tasks.title: Maintain identical-year expectations bridges
tasks.instruction: Keep current inferred and target beliefs on the same fiscal EPS year; distinguish earnings revisions, discounting, multiple changes and interaction. Output: Price bridge.

tasks.title: Test information beyond the price window
tasks.instruction: Identify pre-horizon disclosures about late-period capacity or adoption; do not discard later economics because realized revenue is outside window. Output: Recognition map.

tasks.title: Rank remaining research questions
tasks.instruction: Prioritize missing inputs by eligibility effect, target sensitivity and ability to reverse finalist ordering—not source volume. Output: Search queue.

tasks.title: Log negative and absent disclosures
tasks.instruction: Capture discontinued KPIs, denials, cancellations, contradictions and searched-but-unavailable fields with scope and dates. Output: Missingness audit.

tasks.title: Audit source-to-cell traceability
tasks.instruction: Every reported numeric input maps to a fact and source locator; every modeled number maps to an assumption, formula and sensitivity. Output: Lineage check.

tasks.title: Run synthetic mutation tests
tasks.instruction: Reject future sources, derived leakage, unsealed tests, material untriaged numbers, adoption over deployment capacity and invalid units. Output: Validator report.

tasks.title: Re-evaluate the decision boundary
tasks.instruction: Do not allow best-looking model fit to override missing material economics; compare eligibility and target separately. Output: Challenge verdict.

tasks.title: Publish evidence coverage and test posture
tasks.instruction: Show corpus scope, coverage limitations, forecast lane, holdout performance and contamination status next to the point target. Output: Research packet.

tasks.title: Produce a change-attribution release
tasks.instruction: Explain how new source evidence changed demand, prices, margins, cash, expectations and target; preserve all prior versions. Output: Version delta.

tasks.title: Retain a no-winner outcome
tasks.instruction: Do not force a ranked winner when a missing fact or failed validation decides ordering; publish the blocking question. Output: Eligibility decision.
